settings.title: Settings

feishu.title: Feishu
feishu.description: Reply to your private Feishu messages with an Agent.
feishu.enableHint: The switch saves automatically and affects only your account. Turning it off rejects new messages, including commands, and pauses previously accepted messages awaiting processing and replies awaiting delivery. Turning it back on resumes pending work. Your Agent selection and history are kept; tasks already started are not stopped, and sent replies are not recalled. New messages received while off are not saved for later processing.
feishu.selectBeforeEnable: Save an Agent selection, then turn on chat.
feishu.unlinked: Open Account security → Connected Accounts to link Feishu. If no link action is available, ask an administrator to enable global SSO and Feishu sign-in under External integrations. An administrator can also sync your directory identity.
feishu.unavailable: Selected Agent unavailable. Choose another or clear the selection.
feishu.empty: No published Agents are available to you.
feishu.switchHint: Only text messages in private bot chats are processed. Click Save to switch Agents here, or use /agents to list Agents and /use number (for example, /use 2) to switch in Feishu. Switching affects new messages only; accepted messages and runs stay with their original Agent. Each Agent keeps its own conversation within the same Feishu chat; switching back continues it. Commands: /new starts a fresh conversation when the current run is idle; /stop stops the current task and cancels queued messages; /status shows the selected Agent and run status; /help lists commands.
feishu.failed: Failed to load or save your Feishu settings.

wechat.title: WeChat iLink
wechat.description: Connect WeChat for Agent chat or knowledge collection.
wechat.purposeHint: One purpose per connection: collect into a knowledge base, or run a published Agent. Saving a purpose activates it immediately; the configuration that is not in use is kept.
wechat.purposeBusy: A task is still active on this connection. Wait for it to finish, or stop the Agent task before changing the purpose.
wechat.featuresDisabled: WeChat features are unavailable. Contact an administrator.
wechat.featurePaused: This purpose is paused. Contact an administrator.
wechat.noAgents: No published Agents you can access are available.
wechat.agentVariablesHint: Used for every message. Fields marked * are required.
wechat.agentInactive: No Agent configured. Messages are ignored.
wechat.agentInput: Supports text, images, files, voice and video as permitted by the Agent and team-authorized models; unsupported content gets an explicit reply. Commands: /agents lists accessible published Agents; /use number (for example, /use 2) switches Agents while idle; /new starts a fresh conversation; /stop stops the task and cancels queued messages; /status shows status; /help lists commands; /skip skips a pending Agent question. Wait for tasks, queued messages and replies to finish before switching, then wait for switch confirmation before sending new messages. Configure required variables on the web.
wechat.variableOptionInvalid: Choose one of the available options
wechat.bindingRule: Each WeChat identity has one connection. Each person authorizes their own connection; feature settings are configured separately.
wechat.failed: Unable to load or update WeChat connection settings. Please try again.
wechat.empty: No WeChat connection yet. Scan to authorize.
wechat.targetMissing: Target knowledge base no longer exists
wechat.connectionError: Connection needs attention. Authorize again with a new QR code; documents already collected remain in the knowledge base.
wechat.disabled: Knowledge collection disabled. The connection remains connected.
wechat.noTargets: No writable active knowledge bases are available.
wechat.modelHint: Optional, team-authorized models. Images need vision; audio needs speech recognition unless WeChat provides a transcript. Video samples frames and transcribes its audio (maximum 30 minutes).
wechat.collectionInactive: Knowledge collection off. Received messages are ignored.
wechat.collectionHint: Accepted submissions keep their original knowledge base and permissions are checked again before processing.
wechat.qrLabel: Scan with WeChat to authorize the connection
wechat.bound: WeChat authorization completed. You can now send content to ClawBot.
wechat.disconnectHint: Stop receiving and processing submissions from this connection. Already collected documents remain in the knowledge base. Reconnecting requires WeChat authorization.
wechat.replyHint: Indexed means collection completed. A reply accepted by the WeChat API is not a guarantee that it appeared on your phone.

login.wait: Waiting for WeChat scan and approval…
login.expired: QR code expired. Close it and authorize again.
login.need_verifycode: Enter the verification code displayed in WeChat
login.verify_code_blocked: Verification attempts exceeded. Close this QR code and start authorization again.
